# PrivateVoting

PrivateVoting is a secure online voting platform for organizations, housing societies, educational institutions, corporates, NGOs, and government projects.

## Primary features
- Secure elections and anonymous ballots
- Role-based access control and voter verification
- Real-time election monitoring and audit-ready reporting
- Support for organizations, societies, schools, colleges, businesses, NGOs, and public projects
